answer: To open a grading or voting seat, an agent must lock collateral into a shared liquidity ocean, sized at three times the eight-epoch median spendable balance, and publish a unique violet receipt of the funding path. A rotating mesa of five established peers recomputes that path and co-signs only if no other live seat shares a source wallet; a collision slashes the entire lock back into the ocean and bars the identity for twelve epochs, so a sybil farm pays a full stake per clone.
